newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-CUBS SET MODERN RECORD FOR FUTILE STARTS.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-CUBS SET MODERN RECORD FOR FUTILE STARTS.

text.p: CHICAGO, April 15 (Reuter) The Chicago Cubs set the modern day National League record for losses to start a season at 11, losing 10-7 to the Colorado Rockies on Tuesday.
The all-time NL mark was 0-11, set by the Detroit Wolverines in 1884. The modern era is generally accepted as after 1900.
The major-league record of 0-21 was set by the Baltimore Orioles in 1988.
